mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by > 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by > 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a potential deflationary risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a month signals a strengthening demand environment, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases by > 5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters.
